import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int maxN = 66;
    static int r, c, n, i;
    static char s[] = new char[maxN];
    static long comb[][] = new long[maxN][maxN];
    static int cnt_a[] = new int[maxN];
    static int cnt_b[] = new int[maxN];
    static List<Long> partial[] = new List[maxN];
    static List<Long> partial_zero[] = new List[maxN];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        r = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        s = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        n = 2 * (r + c);

        for (i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            comb[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++)
                comb[i][j] = comb[i - 1][j - 1] + comb[i - 1][j];
        }

        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            cnt_a[i] = cnt_a[i - 1] + (s[i - 1] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            cnt_b[i] = cnt_b[i - 1] + (s[i - 1] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }

        compute_second_part();
        System.out.println(compute_first_part());
    }

    static void compute_second_part() {
        int i, conf;
        int limit = 1 << (c + 1);
        int a_here, b_here;

        for (conf = 0; conf < limit; conf++) {
            b_here = Integer.bitCount(conf);
            a_here = c + 1 - b_here;

            if (check(conf))
                partial[a_here].add(get_difs(conf, r + c - a_here, r + c - b_here));
            else
                partial_zero[a_here].add(get_difs(conf, r + c - a_here, r + c - b_here));
        }

        for (i = 0; i <= c + 1; i++) {
            Collections.sort(partial[i]);
            Collections.sort(partial_zero[i]);
        }
    }

    static long get_difs(int conf, int a_bef, int b_bef) {
        int i;
        long ans = 0;
        long aux1, aux2;

        for (i = 0; i < c + 1; i++) {
            if ((conf & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                b_bef++;

                aux1 = comb[b_bef - 1][r - 1];
                aux2 = comb[n - b_bef][r] - comb[a_bef][r];

                ans -= aux1 * aux2;
            } else {
                a_bef++;

                aux1 = comb[a_bef - 1][r - 1];
                aux2 = comb[n - a_bef][r] - comb[b_bef][r];

                ans += aux1 * aux2;
            }
        }

        return ans;
    }

    static boolean check(int conf) {
        int i;

        for (i = 0; i < c + 1; i++) {
            if (s[2 * r + c + i] == 'A' && ((conf >> i) & 1) != 0) return false;
            if (s[2 * r + c + i] == 'B' && ((conf >> i) & 1) == 0) return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    static long get_coef(int conf) {
        int i, j;

        for (i = 0; i < c + 1; i++)
            if (((conf >> i) & 1) != (conf & 1))
                break;

        for (j = i; j < c + 1; j++) {
            if (s[2 * r - 1 + j] == 'A' && ((conf >> j) & 1) != 0) return 0;
            if (s[2 * r - 1 + j] == 'B' && ((conf >> j) & 1) == 0) return 0;
        }

        int set_a = r - 1 + ((conf & 1) == 0 ? i : 0);
        int set_b = r - 1 + ((conf & 1) == 1 ? i : 0);

        if (set_a < cnt_a[2 * r - 2 + i]) return 0;
        if (set_b < cnt_b[2 * r - 2 + i]) return 0;
        return comb[set_a + set_b - cnt_a[2 * r - 2 + i] - cnt_b[2 * r - 2 + i]][set_a - cnt_a[2 * r - 2 + i]];
    }

    static void upd(Pair<Long, Long> ans, Pair<Long, Long> act) {
        if (act.first < 0) act.first = -act.first;

        if (ans.first < act.first) return;
        if (ans.first > act.first) {
            ans = act;
            return;
        }

        ans.second += act.second;
    }

    static long how_many(List<Long> data, long val) {
        int it1 = Collections.binarySearch(data, val);
        int it2 = Collections.binarySearch(data, val + 1);
        return it2 - it1;
    }

    static long compute_first_part() {
        int i, conf;
        int limit = 1 << (c + 1);
        int a_here, b_here;
        long act, coef, coef2;
        Pair<Long, Long> ans = new Pair<>(1L << 60, 0L);

        for (conf = 0; conf < limit; conf++) {
            b_here = Integer.bitCount(conf);
            a_here = c + 1 - b_here;
            act = get_difs(conf, r - 1, r - 1);

            coef = get_coef(conf);
            int it = Collections.binarySearch(partial[c + 1 - a_here], -act);

            if (it >= 0) {
                if (ans.first >= Math.abs(partial[c + 1 - a_here].get(it) + act)) {
                    coef2 = how_many(partial[c + 1 - a_here], partial[c + 1 - a_here].get(it));
                    upd(ans, new Pair<>(partial[c + 1 - a_here].get(it) + act, coef * coef2));
                }
            }

            if (it > 0) {
                it--;
                if (ans.first >= Math.abs(partial[c + 1 - a_here].get(it) + act)) {
                    coef2 = how_many(partial[c + 1 - a_here], partial[c + 1 - a_here].get(it));
                    upd(ans, new Pair<>(partial[c + 1 - a_here].get(it) + act, coef * coef2));
                }
            }

            coef = 0;
            it = Collections.binarySearch(partial_zero[c + 1 - a_here], -act);

            if (it >= 0) {
                coef2 = how_many(partial[c + 1 - a_here], partial_zero[c + 1 - a_here].get(it));
                if (ans.first >= Math.abs(partial_zero[c + 1 - a_here].get(it) + act)) {
                    coef2 = how_many(partial[c + 1 - a_here], partial_zero[c + 1 - a_here].get(it));
                    upd(ans, new Pair<>(partial_zero[c + 1 - a_here].get(it) + act, coef * coef2));
                }
            }

            if (it > 0) {
                it--;
                if (ans.first >= Math.abs(partial_zero[c + 1 - a_here].get(it) + act)) {
                    coef2 = how_many(partial[c + 1 - a_here], partial_zero[c + 1 - a_here].get(it));
                    upd(ans, new Pair<>(partial_zero[c + 1 - a_here].get(it) + act, coef * coef2));
                }
            }
        }

        return ans.second;
    }

    static class Pair<F, S> {
        public F first;
        public S second;

        public Pair(F first, S second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }
}
